articles.summary: Delivers record third quarter revenue of $70.9 million, representing growth of 39% year-over-year and 6% quarter-over-quarter Increases full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $220 to $235 million Completes the acquisition of ~25,000 acres across the Delaware Basin, increasing LandBridge's contiguity and scale, undeveloped pore space portfolio, and contracted royalty cash flows Announces PowerBridge's conversion of its previously announced option to lease on a portion of the Alpha Digital Campus acreage and commencement of construction on the first phase of the powered data center campus project Declares quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share LandBridge Corporation (NYSE: LB; NYSE TX: LB) (the “Company,” or “LandBridge”) today announced its financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenues of $70.9 million, representing an increase of 39% year-over-year and 6% quarter-over-quarter Net income (1) of $34.0
articles.title: LandBridge Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
